title: Test name claims filter never keeps a file-shaped key, but no file-shaped key is ever supplied and the real filter would keep one
detail: The name asserts a key-shape rejection the body never tests. filter_fields (draft_handler.gleam:78) keeps ANY non-underscore, non-gdpr_consent key <=64 chars — a hand-crafted file-input-named key would be kept (by design, as a <=4000-char scalar). Only the inline comment states the real contract.
recommended_fix: Rename the test to describe what it pins, e.g. filter_fields_keeps_contact_fields_and_truncates_values_test, so the name stops contradicting the filter's actual contract.
